ukberi-tibyan:2-2.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (فَذَلِكَ الَّذِي يَدُعُّ الْيَتِيمَ (٢)).
The words of the Exalted (فَذَلِكَ): the fāʾ is the apodosis (jawāb) of an implied condition, its implied form being: «إِنْ تَأَمَّلْتَهُ» (if you consider him), or «إِنْ طَلَبْتَ عِلْمَهُ» (if you seek to know him). (يَدُعُّ), with a doubled consonant, means «يَدْفَعُ» (he repulses).
It has also been read with a fatḥa on the dāl and a single (undoubled) ʿayn, i.e. he neglects him. And Allah knows best.
